description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 8, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" with a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 30, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains four lines, each representing a different model: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (magenta dashed line with square markers), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with square markers), and an unnamed model (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at approximately (0.5, 20) and increases to around (8, 29.5), with a notable rise between AL values of 0.5 and 4. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at about (0.5, 22.5) and reaches around (8, 29.5), showing a steady increase across the AL range. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line starts at roughly (0.5, 22.5) and ends at approximately (8, 29.5), also exhibiting a steady increase. The red line with star markers starts at around (0.5, 25) and ends at approximately (8, 30.5), displaying a consistent upward trend. All lines show an overall increasing trend as Average Lagging increases.
